questions.question: A psalm of praise tells Israel to sing the LORD a new song. Where does it say His praise should be sung?

answers.text: In the assembly of the godly

questions.question: A psalm tells Israel to praise the LORD with dancing, tambourine and harp. What reason does it give?

answers.text: The LORD takes pleasure in His people
The harvest has finally come in
